competency_fulfillment.rationale: The node asks pupils to read and write similar fractions such as 3/5 or 4/5, but seeds 42-46 all reproduce the unit-fraction stem 'A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 1 part is shaded' with key 1/8. No numerator other than 1 is ever read or written.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Absent entirely: the name-to-symbol direction (three-fifths becoming 3/5), the symbol-to-name direction, and any family of same-denominator fractions that the word 'similar' in the competency refers to. Coverage is limited to a single symbol.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Two short declarative sentences followed by one question, with 'equal parts' as the only technical phrase, is a reasonable reading load for Grade 2 Quarter 4 and does not require multi-step reasoning.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: One template, one denominator and one numerator across five seeds. There is no partitioned-set version, no missing-numerator cloze that would force the pupil to write, and no item showing two similar fractions from the same whole.

competency_alignment.rationale: Since these items are indistinguishable from those served for mat_g2_na_q4_1, the distinct skill of writing non-unit similar fractions is never practised, and the key stays at 1/8 for every seed so difficulty is constant.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The only fraction written is 1/8, and sixteenths appear via the distractor '3/16', which is outside the Grade 2 denominator set of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 that bounds this reading-and-writing node.
